description: This PHP source file defines the PerformanceTrackerLogMenuConfigurator class, which implements the MenuConfigurator interface to configure menu items for the Performance Tracking module in OrangeHRM. It primarily sets the screen to view either the employee's performance tracker list or the user's personal tracker list based on request parameters.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerLogMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Configures menu options for the performance tracker logs, switching the displayed screen based on user request parameters.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the default menu configuration to display either the employee’s or the user's own performance tracker list based on the 'mode' query parameter.
